import pixeltable as pxt

# Initialize pixeltable client
pxt.create_client()

# Get the existing docs table
docs_table = pxt.get_table('docs')

# Add embedding column using the built-in sentence-transformers UDF
docs_table.add_column(
    'content_embedding',
    pxt.functions.sentence_transformers(
        docs_table.content,
        model='all-MiniLM-L6-v2'
    )
)

# Create index for nearest-neighbor lookups
docs_table.create_index('content_embedding', index_type='vector')

# Define query text and get its embedding
query_text = "climate change policy"
query_embedding = pxt.functions.sentence_transformers(
    query_text,
    model='all-MiniLM-L6-v2'
)

# Query for the 5 semantically closest rows, ranked by similarity
results = (
    docs_table.select(
        docs_table.content,
        docs_table.content_embedding.similarity(query_embedding).alias('similarity_score')
    )
    .order_by('similarity_score', desc=True)
    .limit(5)
    .to_pandas()
)

print(results)
